title: Malevolent Force Horror
eyebrow: The Malevolent Force · more horror · round 1
heading: More horror: pick the hand, and say yes or no to the tape look
intro: From the 17 Nov morning call: the force gets more visible, a ghostly hand snatching the price tags. Your library picks: a real Unsplash hand as the reference, a VHS camcorder finish, and suspense strings (the music comes in the next round). Pick one per row and leave a note.

sections.lede: Real photos from Unsplash; the one you pick goes to Flow as the reference for the hand shots (shot 4, the shelf label, and shot 6, the freezer cards). Darkest first.

groups.title: Which hand?
groups.line: Pick the hand the ghost's hand should look like. A note can say what to change (paler, thinner, longer nails…).
